summary_en: ¥5.0B upper limit; 2.4M shares (4.04% of shares outstanding ex-treasury); ¥2,083/share implied ceiling; market purchase via Tokyo Stock Exchange; execution window Aug 14 2026 – Feb 12 2027. Rationale: stock trading substantially below intrinsic value during first half of 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding determination of matters pertaining to acquisition of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 13 August 2026, freee K.K. (TSE Growth: 4478) announced a board resolution to acquire treasury shares under Company Law Article 459(1) and the company's Articles of Incorporation Article 41. The company will acquire up to 2.4 million ordinary shares (4.04% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for an aggregate outlay not exceeding ¥5.0 billion, implying a price ceiling of approximately ¥2,083 per share. Acquisition will proceed via market purchase through a discretionary trading agreement with the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with execution running from 14 August 2026 through 12 February 2027. The company stated that during the first half of 2026, its stock traded at significantly depressed levels that did not reflect its underlying enterprise value, notwithstanding anticipated sustained business growth driven by generative AI and the strengthening of its integrated management platform. The filing notes that acquisition of all or part of the authorized amount may not occur depending on market conditions.
